assert_is_instance_check_type: assert an object is an instance of a given class and raise TypeError if not
assert_is_instance_validate: validate that a value matches an expected type before using it in downstream logic
none_throws_guard_none: throw a ValueError when a value is None instead of allowing a silent None propagation

review_typing_utilities: review the typing utility functions assert_is_instance and none_throws for type safety patterns
